title: Studio: the object designer's field panel offers no Delete Behavior row on a lookup or user field, so `deleteBehavior` cannot be set or cleared from Studio
body:
domain:ui#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRFuJz9QBZqPVHYVhJ

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (measured), from #29733 (PR #29805, report 6596366307). Filed by `domain:ui#2`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** `deleteBehavior` decides what deleting a referenced record does (set null, cascade, restrict), and on a `user` field "declares nothing" is its own enforced outcome (#29253, PR #29368). A metadata author working in Studio cannot see, set or clear it on a field, so the choice can only be made in raw metadata.

**Observed (measured).** `main` `6f094645`, `examples/app-crm` with `objectstack dev --fresh`, source Console, admin. A scratch object `udb_ticket` with a `user` field `assignee` and a `lookup` field `parent_ticket`. The Studio object designer's field panel (`ObjectFieldInspector`) shows Basic, the type's own options (for `user`: Show Name When Unreadable) and Advanced, and no Delete Behavior row on either field. On `origin/main` no app-shell source outside `predicate.ts` (a doc comment) names `deleteBehavior`. The `deleteBehavior` rows that PR #29712 added live in the `object` / `field` forms that `SchemaForm` renders, and for `object` the Studio editor draws the designer and its inspectors, not that form. Screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29733/before-user-field-panel-no-deleteBehavior.png`, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29733/lookup-field-panel-no-deleteBehavior.png`.

**Wanted.** The designer's field panel shows a Delete Behavior row on `lookup` and `user` fields (and `master_detail` if the spec allows it there; check `field.zod.ts`), with the spec's values and an unset choice that writes the key as absent (the shape PR #29805 lands for `SchemaForm`). Its visibility follows the same predicate the form rows use.

**Tests.** Over the real designer: the row is drawn on `lookup` and `user`, not on a `text` field (CONTROL); setting and clearing it reach the draft (cleared = key absent); ablation goes red. Live before/after in Studio.

**Landing site:** the Studio object designer's field inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector`, app-shell metadata-admin). Serialize after PR #29805.

Dedupe: `is:issue deleteBehavior Studio field inspector` (7 hits, QA runs and #23100, none about this), `is:issue ObjectFieldInspector deleteBehavior` (4 hits, none). **New.**

Links back: #29733, PR #29805, PR #29712, #29415, #29253.
